```yaml
name: Claude Auto-Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  claude-auto-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Add Reown tone of voice guidance
        run: |
          echo "## Reown Tone of Voice Guidance" > reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
          echo "" >> reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
          echo "This document contains the official tone of voice guidance for Reown." >> reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md

      - name: Configure Anthropic API key
        run: echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Claude auto-review
        uses: WalletConnect/actions/claude/auto-review@master
        with:
          project_context: |
            # Project Context
            ## Mintlify Docs Architecture
            The Mintlify docs are organized into several sections, including tutorials, guides, and API references. Each section follows a consistent structure to ensure clarity and ease of navigation.

            ## Content Structure
            - **Tutorials**: Step-by-step guides on how to use various features of Mintlify.
            - **Guides**: Detailed explanations of specific topics related to Mintlify.
            - **API References**: Comprehensive documentation of the Mintlify API endpoints.

            ## Domain-Specific Web3/Multichain Knowledge
            The Mintlify docs cover a wide range of Web3 and multichain technologies, including Ethereum, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, and more. Each topic includes examples, best practices, and troubleshooting tips.

            ## Review Focus Areas
            - Clarity and conciseness of the text.
            - Accuracy and completeness of information.
            - Consistency with the overall tone and style of the Mintlify docs.
            - Compliance with the Reown tone of voice guidelines.
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git add reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
          git commit -m "Add Reown tone of voice guidance and configure Claude auto-review"
          git push origin main
```
